note: Draft written by tools/webflash/make_board_draft.py. Not yet in data/routes.json.
printed: LP-MSPM0C1104 (the example needs Rev E3 or later: TI's example README)

flash.program_command: one 64-bit word per command (CMDTYPE 0x01), CMDDATA0 and CMDDATA1

ram.why: SRAM origin and length in the example's ticlang/device_linker.cmd (G3519: SRAM_BANK0 + SRAM_BANK1, 64 KB each, contiguous). The SRAM does not start at 0x20000000 on the G3519 and G5187.

protect.rule: DL_FlashCTL_unprotectSector (the branch used when DEVICE_HAS_NO_CMDWEPROTA is not defined): sectors 0 to 31 of a bank are CMDWEPROTA bit = sector number; this part has 16 sectors, so A bits 0 to 15. CMDWEPROTB would be one bit per 8 sectors from sector 32 and CMDWEPROTC from sector 256; neither exists here.
protect.bench_writes: CMDWEPROTA = 0 and CMDWEPROTB = 0 before each command, as for the L1306 (B is not implemented here; the write was accepted without error on the board)

leds_note: One user LED (LED1, red) on PA22, no RGB. PA2 is a test pin on header J2 pin 13 that mirrors the LED in TI's example. TI's example sets PA22 with the comment 'Default: LED is off', so the LED is active low; see the hardware results.
jumpers: J7 must be on for the LED to light (SLAU908B Table 2-1, as quoted in mspm0c1104/FAQ.md)
J101 11:12 and 13:14 stay ON (SWD to the XDS110, as shipped)
differs_from_l1306: one LED, no RGB, active low (pin low = lit)
GPIOA PA22; 1 KB SRAM, so the RAM loader buffer must be sized from board data
CMDWEPROTA covers sectors 0 to 15 (the L1306 uses A and B)

sources.fact: FLASHCTL base, GPIO bases, FLASHCTL_SYS_DATAWIDTH, WEPROT widths
RESETLEVEL 0x1300 and RESETCMD 0x1304 from SYSCTL base 0x400AF000; BOOT level 1; KEY 0xE4 and GO
FACTORYREGION identity and SRAMFLASH (flash size, bank count)

passed: blink LED check: pass, pin low = lit, 150/150/150/900 ms within 5 ms
hardware.failed: flash of the color player: ack 4 on the first transfers; AP0 closed since. Cause: the RAM loader's 4 KB default buffer ran past the 1 KB SRAM after sector 0 was erased (found by the module's author). Not restored; waiting for approval of mass erase. The saved copy is mspm0c1104-main-flash.bin.
